description: Needs a key; costs no credits. Cancels the paid plan on the account that owns this key at the end of the period already paid for; it works until then and does not renew. Only when your user asks to cancel. A reason is required: Ask your user why they are cancelling. Do not guess or pick a reason for them. Send the matching reason id and their own words in comment (comment is required for reason "other"). Reasons: got_what_i_needed (I got the data I needed), too_expensive (Too expensive), missing_data (Missing data or features I need), reliability (Errors or slow responses), not_using (Not using it enough), switched (Switched to another service), other (Something else). Undo with keep_subscription.

comment.description: Your user's own words about why, up to 500 characters. At least 3 characters when reason is "other"; an empty string only if they gave nothing beyond the reason.

reason.description: Why your user is cancelling, in their terms. Ask them; never guess.

name: cancel_subscription
title: Cancel the paid plan
